what: Fills the panel with a grid of 16px squares (32px gap, centered) and tints squares within 180px of the cursor toward the accent color the closer they are (1 − distance/180). When the cursor moves over 80px per second, squares inside the radius are pushed by inertia away from the cursor (+ .005 of cursor velocity, resistance 750), stop, then return to place with 1.5s elastic.out(1, .75) — the gray dot field under the footer spreads yellow following the hand, and when swung it scatters, then gathers with a wobble. On devices with no pointer, a band tinted by the scroll ratio sweeps the panel from bottom to top.

options.fling: Cursor speed (px/s) at which pushing starts, default 80 — set very large and it only tints
options.back: Time to return to place (s), default 1.5
options.--fx-base · --fx-hot: Box background · tint color (CSS variables), default stage text contrast 22% · --kf-accent

note: Without InertiaPlugin, a distance computed with the same resistance is pushed with power2.out. On devices without hover and on phones the original plays a scroll-bound video (dot-plate image), here the same plate is swept and tinted by scroll ratio instead of a video.
